name: Brew Lab
tagline: Coffee brewed in front of you: a dripper, a scale and four quiet minutes
niche: Specialty coffee shop and manual brew bar

listing.description: A site for a specialty coffee shop or manual brew bar. White space and a single blue, drops falling into a cup, and a dripper that fills as the guest scrolls through the ritual.

seo.title: Brew Lab — specialty coffee and pour-over in Tashkent
seo.description: A coffee shop in Mirobod: V60, Chemex and AeroPress brewed by weight, espresso on freshly roasted beans and home-brewing workshops. Open from 8 am.
seo.answer: Brew Lab is a specialty coffee shop at 12 Mirobod St in Tashkent, open 8:00–21:00 on weekdays and 9:00–22:00 at weekends. A V60 filter costs 38,000 UZS, a cappuccino 32,000 UZS and a two-hour home-brewing workshop 250,000 UZS. The beans are roasted in Tashkent at least once a week.

sections.title: Coffee brewed by weight
sections.subtitle: Eighteen grams of coffee, three hundred grams of water at 93 degrees and three and a half minutes. The barista brews every cup in front of you and tells you where it comes from.

sections.label: The shop
sections.title: A small bar where coffee is the main course
sections.text: Ten seats at the bar and a big table by the window. No syrups and no whipped cream — just beans from three or four farms that change every month, and a barista who will suggest what to try: berry-bright Ethiopia, chocolatey Colombia or something entirely new.

items.title: Grind
items.text: We grind 18 grams of beans medium, like sea salt, right before brewing.

items.title: Rinse
items.text: We rinse the paper with hot water to lose the paper taste and warm the dripper.

items.title: Bloom
items.text: 50 grams of water and a 40-second wait while the coffee releases gas and rises in a dome.

items.title: Pour
items.text: A thin spiral stream in three pours brings it up to 300 grams.

items.title: Cup
items.text: At 3:30 it is ready. Taste it hot, then warm — the flavour opens up as it cools.

items.name: V60
items.text: Clean and bright, best for Ethiopia

items.name: Chemex
items.text: For two, 500 ml, soft and sweet

items.name: AeroPress
items.text: Dense and full-bodied, ready in two minutes

items.name: Cold brew
items.text: Steeped for 18 hours, served over ice

items.name: Canelé
items.text: Rum and vanilla, baked every morning

items.quote: I tried filter coffee without milk for the first time and realised coffee can smell of strawberries.
items.author: Madina

items.quote: Went to the workshop, bought a dripper — now I brew just as well at home.
items.author: Timur

items.quote: Quiet, delicious and nobody rushes you. The best place to work until lunch.
items.author: Anna

items.q: How is filter different from an americano?
items.a: Filter is brewed slowly through paper: the taste is cleaner and brighter and there is more caffeine. An americano is espresso topped up with water.

items.q: Can I buy beans to take home?
items.a: Yes, 250-gram bags from 145,000 UZS. We will grind them for your dripper, cezve or espresso machine.
Saturdays at 11:00, up to six people. Two hours for 250,000 UZS, beans and filters to take home included.
Oat and almond, at no extra cost.

items.q: Can I order ahead to take away?
items.a: Yes: leave an order on the site or in Telegram and it will be ready when you arrive.

sections.label: Contact
sections.title: Come in for a cup
sections.text: 12 Mirobod — a five-minute walk from Oybek metro. Parking in the courtyard.
